market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver would need to reach a price more than double its all-time high (≈$50) and over 3× current levels by mid‑2026. Such an extreme move within 15 months has no historical precedent and would require catastrophic inflation or supply shock; a probability well below 1% is far more realistic than the market’s 6.8%.
evidence_points: Silver all-time high settlement is around $50 (1980, 2011).
Current front-month SI futures are near $33, so $120 is a ~260% increase.
Implied volatility for deep out-of-the-money calls would price this event very cheaply, consistent with sub-1% probability.
No near-term fundamental drivers (e.g., global monetary collapse, massive industrial demand shock) make tripling plausible in 15 months.
sources_consulted: Current Silver spot/futures pricing (as of late March 2025)
Options market for extreme tail events
